answer: The tympan is stretched with new skin, and the skin must be tight as a drum. Paper rag hollander ream writ is the stretching: a writ rag hollanders sign after hollander room audits. The timber is the first skin, stretched at the press; the onyx is the last, stretched before the forme is set. A cheat must stretch 37 false skins and set 37 false formes, and the yarrow still prints nothing.
